query_grammars.pageToken: opaque token, base64 (standard or URL-safe), 1..2048 characters, checked as text by the final check; outside it refused naming the parameter
query_grammars.after_id: Claude model id (model_ids.CLAUDE); outside it refused naming the parameter
query_grammars.before_id: Claude model id (model_ids.CLAUDE); outside it refused naming the parameter
query_grammars.client_version: three numeric components, each1..6digits; chatgpt.codex.models.1 (required) and openai.models.1 (optional, Codex's command-auth providers)
query_grammars.nextToken: opaque token, printable ASCII without whitespace (AWS documents no whitespace), 1..2048 characters, checked as text by the final check; outside it refused naming the parameter

not_authorized: arbitrary provider/resource/project IDs; a model list's cursor only within its grammar; a session or request id only within its agent's id grammar

header_policy.inspected: finite content/accept/version/beta enums and grammars in immutable source
header_policy.framing: inbound removed/regenerated; raw duplicates refuse; generated occurrences included
header_policy.credentials: Exact profile-declared destination-bound roles, decided before any removable family; explicit Azure/Foundry profile alone declares api-key. API-version expectations never grant a header/query family.
header_policy.sibling_rule: same envelope policy for Anthropic rewrite/Claude/subscription/auto-review/cloud content selection; no marker widens permission
checked: an OpenAI or ChatGPT originator outside Codex's first-party set, within the product-id grammar
header_policy.ambient_client: cookies/custom default additions refuse before build
header_policy.removable_from_environment: Claude Code 2.1.316 copies x-claude-remote-session-id, x-claude-remote-container-id, x-claude-remote-session-origin and x-client-app from environment values (CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_CONTAINER_ID, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ORIGIN, CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP): free text, removed on the anthropic and bedrock families
header_policy.removable_codex_free: Codex c1382380 x-openai-subagent (a kind or SubAgentSource::Other's label): free, removed on the openai and chatgpt families
header_policy.removable_agent_ids: x-claude-code-agent-id and x-claude-code-parent-agent-id (Claude Code 2.1.316 subagents): observed as 'a' + 16 lowercase hex, but the source's id function also makes a{label}-{16 hex} from an agent name hint, so free text: removed on the anthropic and bedrock families, never forwarded
header_policy.removable_tool_names: x-claude-code-prev-tool-durations (Claude Code's gateway hint header, its gateway compatibility guide read 2026-11-05): the tools whose results a request carries, <name>=<ms>;..., an MCP server's and tool's own names among them, which a user chooses; a hint the guide says a gateway need not forward: removed on the anthropic and bedrock families
header_policy.removable_never: no family is a prefix holding a credential or signing material: never x-amz- (x-amz-security-token, x-amz-date, x-amz-content-sha256), never x-goog- (x-goog-api-key, x-goog-user-project)

named_grammars.accept-encoding: every profile: identity, gzip, deflate, br, zstd in any order, each at most once, optional q=0..1 with up to 3 decimals
named_grammars.anthropic-version: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum 2023-06-01
named_grammars.anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-acces: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum true
named_grammars.x-app: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum cli, cli-bg (Claude Code 2.1.316)
named_grammars.anthropic-beta: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: 1..32 comma-separated [a-z0-9-]{1,64} tokens, optional spaces around commas
named_grammars.x-initiator: openai and anthropic families: enum user, agent (Copilot CLI BYOK; VS Code Copilot chatMLFetcher.ts:1527)
named_grammars.x-interaction-type: openai and anthropic families: [a-z0-9_-]{1,32} (Copilot CLI 1.0.103 api.schema.json: an open string)
named_grammars.originator: openai and chatgpt families: <=64 characters, one [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]* token, optionally after Codex's first-party 'Codex ' prefix, no other space; codex_cli_rs, codex-tui, codex_vscode, codex_atlas, codex_chatgpt_desktop inspected, any other checked (Codex c1382380 login/src/auth/default_client.rs:42-150)
named_grammars.version: openai and chatgpt families: three numeric components, each 1..6 digits (Codex c1382380 model-provider-info/src/lib.rs:526-543)
named_grammars.x-codex-beta-features: openai and chatgpt families: 1..32 comma-separated [a-z0-9_.]{1,64} feature keys, no spaces (Codex c1382380 core/src/session/mod.rs:1245-1258)
named_grammars.x-codex-routing-hint: openai and chatgpt families: model={OpenAI model grammar}[;tier=auto|default|flex|priority], at most 160 characters (Codex c1382380 core/src/client.rs:1164-1180)
named_grammars.x-openai-memgen-request: openai and chatgpt families: enum true (client.rs:797-800)
named_grammars.x-codex-turn-state: openai and chatgpt families: [A-Za-z0-9_.=-]{1,1024}, the provider's own opaque sticky-routing token echoed back (Codex c1382380 core/src/client.rs:2337-2352); named, not removed
named_grammars.x-responsesapi-include-timing-metrics: openai and chatgpt families: enum true (client.rs:1331-1337)
named_grammars.x-openai-internal-codex-responses-lite: openai and chatgpt families: enum true (client.rs:2355-2362)
named_grammars.x-claude-code-request-class: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: [a-z_]{1,32} (Claude Code 2.1.316 gateway hint headers: main, subagent, auxiliary, compaction, workflow)
named_grammars.x-claude-code-agent-type: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]{0,63} (a built-in agent's name, custom or teammate)
named_grammars.x-anthropic-additional-protection: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum true (CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_PROTECTION)
named_grammars.x-claude-code-compaction: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum auto, manual, reactive (Claude Code's gateway hint header on a compaction; its gateway compatibility guide, read 2026-11-05)
named_grammars.x-claude-code-context-compacted: anthropic family and Bedrock model calls: enum auto, manual, reactive (the hint on the first request after a compaction)

id_grammars.x-claude-code-session-id: UUID 8-4-4-4-12 hex, either case (Claude Code 2.1.312-2.1.316: --session-id 'Must be a valid UUID'; crypto.randomUUID())
id_grammars.session-id: UUID, optionally prefixed memory_consolidation: or guardian: (Codex c1382380 core/src/client.rs:580-603, protocol/src/protocol.rs:3100-3107, core/src/guardian/review_session.rs:286-298)
id_grammars.x-client-request-id: UUID, the thread id (Codex c1382380 codex-api/src/endpoint/responses.rs:86-90, core/src/client.rs:1312-1318); or Hermes Agent's prompt_cache_key, pck_ and 24 hex digits, or its session id (hermes-agent 25ce7ccf agent/transports/codex.py:428-449, 864-872)
id_grammars.session_id: [0-9]{8}_[0-9]{6}_[0-9a-f]{6}, Hermes Agent's session id (hermes-agent 25ce7ccf hermes_state_ids.py:53-60), sent as ChatGPT's session_id header (agent/transports/codex.py:864-872)
id_grammars.chatgpt-account-id: UUID (Codex c1382380 login/src/token_data.rs:85-120 chatgpt_account_id; config/src/config_toml.rs:130 workspace id; a weak anchor: Codex reads the claim opaquely)
id_grammars.x-codex-parent-thread-id: UUID (Codex c1382380 core/src/responses_metadata.rs:394-400, a subagent's parent ThreadId)
id_grammars.x-claude-code-prompt-id: UUID (Claude Code 2.1.316 sends it only when /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i matches)

header_policy.id_rule: every profile; inspected by grammar, never an exact configured value, never selection, identity or exception authority (D7); outside its grammar refused naming the header
header_policy.unknown: refused; bounded printable name agent-only, shared category has no name/value
header_policy.value_refused: envelope-header-value; the header name agent-only, never its value
header_policy.user_configured: a header the user configures for an agent (ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS, Codex http_headers/env_http_headers, COPILOT_PROVIDER_HEADERS) stays refused naming it until a destination names it through P2-6's approval

model_grammars.bedrock_path: optional system-defined inference profile prefix us., eu., apac., global., us-gov., jp., au.; anthropic.claude-{family}[-version] [-YYYYMMDD] [-vN[:M]] [:NNNk] (InvokeModel and unversioned ids)

model_grammars.vertex_express_path: /gemini/v1beta1/publishers/google/models/{gemini model grammar}:{operation} to https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1beta1/publishers (GenAI's Vertex AI express mode under latet run), the key query or x-goog-api-key a credential
model_grammars.gemini_path: gemini-[N[.N]-](pro|flash|embedding)[-word]{0,5} from a closed vocabulary and numeric revisions or dates; text-embedding-00N
model_grammars.model_read_path: Claude's first-party form on Anthropic, OpenAI's on the others
model_grammars.body_model: Gemini's on the Gemini destination, Claude's first-party form for Anthropic's protocol, OpenAI's for Chat Completions, Responses and embeddings; else an exact row
model_grammars.families: claude: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, mythos and the 3.x order claude-N[-N]-(opus|sonnet|haiku); openai: gpt-N[.N][o], gpt-oss, oN, chatgpt-4o, codex with a closed variant vocabulary, text-embedding-3-small/-3-large/-ada-002
